Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we join sentences correctly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words
2. use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences
3. appreciate the correct use of conjunctions in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 WORD CLASSES: CONJUNCTIONS – BECAUSE, THAT, WHEN, IF, UNLES
This lesson teaches Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the correct use of conjunctions in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles above.
2. Explain Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unles important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we join sentences correctly?
2. Why do we use conjunctions?
3. How can one join two or more sentences?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words
2. use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences
3. appreciate the correct use of conjunctions in communication
